conventions.note: Blocks import `catalog`, `config` and `routes` from src/lib/catalog.ts and `resolveImage` from src/lib/images.ts. Both files ship in the template; keep those exports if you restructure.

blocks.name: product-card
blocks.description: Grid card: image, name, SKU, price, sale badge

blocks.name: buy-button
blocks.description: Quantity + Buy Now form that POSTs a SKU to /api/checkout. Works without JavaScript.

blocks.name: product-gallery
blocks.description: Hero image with thumbnail switcher; degrades to the primary image without JavaScript

blocks.name: category-nav
blocks.description: Chip list of child categories for a category page

blocks.name: site-header
blocks.description: Sticky header with primary nav and a mobile menu listing top-level categories

blocks.name: site-footer
blocks.description: Footer with category links, contact and legal nav

blocks.name: checkout
blocks.description: Stripe Checkout: the /api/checkout endpoint, the webhook receiver, and the success page. Prices come from the catalogue on the server.

blocks.name: contact-form
blocks.description: Contact form with honeypot, posting to /api/contact which sends via SendGrid

blocks.name: order-lookup
blocks.description: Order status by email + reference, read live from Stripe. The seed of the customer portal; needs no SKU.io API.

blocks.name: cart
blocks.description: Browser cart: Add to cart button, header badge, and a /cart page that checks out every line in one Stripe session. Snapshots are display-only; the server re-prices.

blocks.name: account
blocks.description: Customer portal: passwordless sign-in by emailed link, order history with fulfilment and tracking, reorder into the cart. Needs a provider with the customers capability (SKU.io); degrades to order-lookup without one.
